text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, will victory belong to the 
incarnation of light, or the raging wild? 
Which will it be?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: However! But breaking through the pack is—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Dants, it's Dants, Dants Flame! Do 
not forget about this Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I really did it... I beat 
Pokke-chan...! And Tachyon-chan too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
This should let even more people see me. 
Please remember my name, even if that's 
all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You've got it down already. You're 
amazing, Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Dants, huh. Honestly, I didn't see that 
coming, partner...
choice_data_list:
Sorry... I was completely distracted by 
Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I lost track of the marking. I didn't have 
the leeway to advise them to watch out for 
the others as well.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, we just weren't good 
enough. And Dants was strong, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon was just strong enough to 
captivate everyone's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, there's something I need to tell 
you. Today, not yet—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This is just the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The beginning—what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to deciding who stands at 
the top—the leader of our generation— it's 
undeniably the next race, the Nippon 
Derby."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat you at the very pinnacle! Only 
by doing that can I be the strongest of 
our generation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... I see. Well, that makes sense. I 
want that too, after all. To beat you in 
the Derby. Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Being defeated, that is.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Beaten?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However, light converges where it 
ought to converge. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the end of a beginning, and the start 
of the next. See you, Pokke-kun.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't get this at all... Hey, Tachyon! 
You'd better brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'll damn well show 'em at the Japanese 
Derby. The roar of the demon, my most 
terrifying run!"
